reason: This touches the core `expression.EvalContext` abstraction and propagates that change across many builtin, vectorized, aggregation, executor, and table paths. Even if framed as exposing fields, this is central shared runtime context for expression evaluation and can affect SQL semantics, session-dependent behavior, NULL/time/string handling, aggregation correctness, and partition/table evaluation in subtle ways. The breadth and cross-cutting nature make it worth a focused deep review for high-severity regressions.
